data.long_meaning: Angelina derives from the Latin 'Angelus', meaning 'Messenger of God'. In Christian tradition, angels are celestial beings sent by God to bring His messages or to minister to those in need. The name Angelina is a tribute to the celestial beings that carry God's love and care to humanity. The name Angelina carries the meaning “Messenger of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Angelina usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אנג'לינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אנג'לינה נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'אנג'לוס', שפירושה מלאך, ומוסיף את הסופית הנשית '-ינה'. הוא מתאר אישה המהווה שליחת אלוהים, נושאת בשורה טובה ומבשרת טובות לאנושות. השם קשור קשר הדוק למלאכים המוזכרים בכתבי הקודש, אשר משמשים כשליחי אלוהים ומבצעים את רצונו.

in_greek.name: Αγγελίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αγγελίνα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'άγγελος', που σημαίνει αγγελιοφόρος ή μήνυμα. Σε χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα συμβολίζει μια γυναίκα που λειτουργεί ως αγγελιοφόρος του Θεού, μεταφέροντας μηνύματα ελπίδας, αγάπης και σωτηρίας. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, οι άγγελοι θεωρούνται ως οι απεσταλμένοι του Θεού, που εκτελούν το θέλημά Του.

in_latin.name: Angelina
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Angelina is derived from the Latin term 'angelus', which translates to angel or messenger. In Christian tradition, the name signifies a woman who serves as a divine messenger, conveying God's love, mercy, and guidance to humanity. Throughout history, the name has been associated with virtues such as compassion, kindness, and devotion to spiritual pursuits.

in_english.name: Angelina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Angelina originates from the Greek word 'angelos', meaning messenger or angel. In Christian tradition, Angelina symbolizes a woman who embodies the qualities of angels, such as purity, kindness, and devotion to serving others. The name has been popularized by several saints and martyrs throughout history, including Saint Angelina of Serbia. Today, the name Angelina is used across various Christian cultures, signifying a person of spiritual significance and divine guidance.
